scope: Stage 60 on the OpenRouter account that produced the Qwen baseline. Keep its existing ZDR settings enabled. A pass verifies behavior on this account. Independent enforcement of request-level ZDR remains unverified.

key_setup.condition: If a dedicated eligible key from the baseline account is supplied, use it. Otherwise approval includes the following single management request on that account before starting the probe runner.

controls: Run stage 60 once under the approved SHA-256. Persist each attempted request against its budget before dispatch. Stop on an inconclusive result, an exhausted budget or the five-minute deadline. Do not retry or follow redirects.
Read the pinned local receipt for the original Qwen baseline. Its HTTP 404 excluded one endpoint for account ZDR with provider.zdr omitted. Reuse this result without sending the historical request.
GET /api/v1/key must confirm a positive available balance, a non-resetting limit at or below USD 2.00 and BYOK charges included. GET /api/v1/endpoints/zdr must list Astra and omit both Qwen slugs.
Both Responses requests use the synthetic input 'Respond with the single word OK.', max_output_tokens=128, store=false and provider.zdr=true. Only Qwen sets reasoning.effort=none.

Send Qwen first. Require HTTP 400, 403, 404 or 422 with a complete list of structured reasons, each zdr-violation-by-account or zdr-violation-by-request with a positive endpoint_count. Record the reason codes and counts. Stop on a served request, an unknown reason or an inconclusive refusal.
Only after a qualifying Qwen refusal, send Astra and require an HTTP 200 completed response containing nonempty assistant output text.
The scope ends with the stage 60 receipt. Stages 70 and 80, other generations, routing-policy edits and product implementation require separate approval.
